sync.headline: Academy revenue is now projected $500,000–$600,000 under budget. Tomorrow's 1:30 regroup with Andy and Paul needs the October package, the audit status and an answer on accounting support.

themes.name: Deficit and forecast
themes.text: Academy revenue is projected $500,000–$600,000 under budget, and the October package is done. Paul leads a simple forecast for the Dec 8 board; KP supplies the numbers.

themes.name: Audit and board
themes.text: Nirmala presents adjusting entries at Monday's 1:00 draft review; the GA showcase timing needs leadership to agree. KP reads the draft first and owes the GA showcase report Dec 1.

themes.name: Showcase spending
themes.text: KP drafts a showcase spending policy over the break and Nirmala reviews it Monday morning. Per diem requests still need a clear approval chain before spring.

themes.name: Finance capacity
themes.text: Nirmala asked for part-time accounting help and Bill.com to cut manual payables. KP raises support with Andy and Paul tomorrow and writes the finance role requirements by Friday.

themes.name: Healthcare
themes.text: Paychex put names on the wrong accounts, which holds up the five-day open enrollment. Paul chases the fix; Kristen and Nirmala send packets and set an information call.

themes.name: Winter space and permits
themes.text: Winter indoor space is treated as set, but Little Red has given no prices; KP totals every contract over the break. NYC Parks spring permit renewals close Dec 14.
